body: Quran Lock is being built around a simple rule: the distracting apps you choose stay closed until you complete your reading goal. A few minutes is enough to begin. If something urgent comes up, the planned flow includes an emergency bypass. The goal is structure without shame — not a verdict on you.
caption: Coming to Tilawah Lock: choose the distracting apps, set a Quran reading goal, and unlock after completion. Pray. Read. Then unlock.
cta: Follow Tilawah Lock for launch updates.
